## Summary

Describe the change and the evidence it adds or updates.

## Change classification

- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Test or tooling only
- [ ] Staged integration design
- [ ] Production-facing integration (requires named release approval)

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated where applicable
- [ ] Relevant checks pass or inherited failures are explicitly recorded
- [ ] Scope is focused and linked to an issue/decision record
- [ ] No credentials, member data, or raw webhook payloads were committed

## Contribution evidence

- [ ] Feature / implementation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation or tutorial
- [ ] Peer review
- [ ] Course improvement

## Bonus-system declaration

- [ ] This change does **not** award credits, redeem points, create coupons, send member messages, or update Wix member data.
- [ ] If it touches GitHub-to-bonus intake, it remains pending-only and follows `docs/GITHUB_BONUS_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md`.
- [ ] Identity mapping and idempotency behaviour are covered where applicable.

## External side effects

State `none`, or list the exact approved systems and effect.
